features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries
features.evidence: IndexingService now splits documents into ~500-character paragraph-aware chunks, falls back to word-boundary splits for oversized paragraphs, stores chunk metadata under chunks/<doc-id>.json, records chunk IDs in index/index-meta.json, and updates document status/chunk count after indexing. Verified with npm run check, npm test (5 tests), npm run build, and Electron launch showing Knowledge Base window.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, and file type metadata from documents
features.evidence: DocumentService.importDocument stores metadata.wordCount, metadata.lineCount, and metadata.fileType; DocumentDetail displays those fields. Verified with npm run check, npm test (3 tests), npm run build, and Electron launch showing Knowledge Base window.
